resources.string: "Four layouts"
"Classic, Spotlight, Console and Drift each arrange Home and Library their own way. The bars, the full-screen player and Search can follow along or get a layout of their own."
"Made for you"
"Daily mixes, a mix for the time of day, Recommended songs, Discover and artist stations on Home, each with its own cover. Like a mix to keep a dated copy in your Library."
"What the lyrics mean"
"Turn on Lyric meanings in Integrations to see what a line means and read About this song, from Genius."
"YouTube comments"
"Comments from a song's YouTube video sit beside SoundCloud's. Signed in to YouTube Music, you can post and like them too."
"Spotify playlist folders"
"Your Spotify folders show up in Library. Create, rename and delete them, and move playlists in and out."
"Your plays count on Spotify"
"Turn on Mirror plays to Spotify in Playback to play each Spotify song muted in Spotify's web player, so it shows up in Recently played, your recommendations and Wrapped. Premium only."
"Apple Music, no subscription needed"
"Like songs and make playlists without a subscription. They stay on this device until you subscribe, then move to your account. Liked Songs and deleting playlists work too."
"Pick the right copy"
"Every song menu has Playback source and Wrong song? Pick another, and Copy link shares a song from any source it's on."
"Long titles scroll in the mini player"
"Smoother motion, with animated now playing bars"
"Liquid Glass follows your accent, bars and player layout"
"Appearance is split into Themes, Layouts, Text, Player and Home & Library"
"Website and Discord links in About"
"Music keeps playing when you swipe Aurora away"
"The notification and widget open the full player"
"Back closes the full player first"
"Songs on an SD card show up once you pick their folder"
"The mini player's heart follows your accent"
"Plays show up in your SoundCloud history"
"Playback source marks the right copy after a swap"
"The window closes straight away"
